about: A fixed set of tags with the verdict the review model should give each one.
All projects and events here are invented.
Each entry names its case, the tag (name, description), how many memories use it, up to three of them, the verified tags the model is shown, and what is expected.
expected.verdict must match. For a merge, expected.into must match too; a rename is checked on the verdict only.
floor is the overall pass rate the test asserts: the lowest of three runs, rounded down (18/20 in each of three runs with qwen3:14b).

tag.name: kubernetes
tag.description: the cluster the services run on: pods, nodes, manifests

memories.content: Pinned the pod memory limit at 512 MB because the worker leaked past 1 GB and took the node down.
A readiness probe on the database port made every pod restart during a failover, so the probe now calls /health.
The staging cluster has three nodes; production has six.
